info.description: PLANNED CONTRACT 2026-10-26, NOT IMPLEMENTED. Go HTTP-first target. This file is documentation, not a running server or claim of tested OpenAPI conformance. Includes copied-source collections and required scheduled/realtime sync; no desktop framework dependency.

get.summary: Realtime change stream (Server-Sent Events)
get.description: Owner token. Emits `hello` on connect, then `changed` whenever the daemon wrote state; both carry {"version":N}. Bursts are coalesced (≥150 ms apart). Clients re-read the resources they show; nothing is replayed after a reconnect. A `: ping` comment is sent every 15 s. At most 16 streams are open at once (429 too_many_streams).

post.summary: Stop the daemon gracefully
post.description: Owner token. Answers 202 and stops shortly after: the API stops accepting requests, workers reach safe points and running jobs resume on the next start. Used by the tray's Quit.

501.description: This daemon cannot be stopped over HTTP

post.summary: Create a folder in the owner's Drive
post.description: Owner only. Idempotent: the write carries an intent derived from the key, the parent and the name, so a retry returns the same folder (`Idempotency-Replayed: true`). No sharing is changed.

post.description: One active job per collection. The audit is a durable read-only job; findings land in /v1/audits/{audit_id}.

put.description: Changes only what later runs copy; nothing already at the destination is removed, and a running job keeps its own rule. expected_revision must equal the collection revision (409 stale_revision otherwise).

post.summary: Stop following a collection; keep the copy and mappings
post.description: Own collection or owner. Turns off scheduled and realtime sync; no Drive change. 409 collection_busy names the active job. Idempotent; expected revision required.

post.description: Own collection or owner. Deletes local records only (collection, mappings, job history, sync settings, audits); never touches Drive. Requires retired state. Idempotent; expected revision required.

post.summary: Admit a cleanup job for a retired collection
post.description: Own collection or owner. Moves the 502Drive-created destination root to the Drive trash only (never permanent delete), only when it carries the 502Drive intent marker. dry_run defaults to true. Real runs need confirm_name equal to the root name. 202 is the admitted durable job, not completion.

202.description: Own collection or owner. Moves the 502Drive-created destination root to the Drive trash only (never permanent delete), only when it carries the 502Drive intent marker. dry_run defaults to true. Real runs need confirm_name equal to the root name. 202 is the admitted durable job, not completion.

get.description: Principal-scoped. Owners may pass all=true. Orders by updated_at, so an old job that ran again recently is included.

BearerAuth.description: Opaque random token from protected client file; maps to principal server-side

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Principal/method/path scoped. Replay uses saved response; different payload returns 409.

deep.description: Scan the whole source read-only in the background (S7). Poll GET /v1/plans/{plan_id} until deep.complete or a final state.

on_conflict.description: Decision for a name already taken at the destination (never overwrites).
Decision for a name already taken at the destination (never overwrites).

mode.description: Omit to refuse a second copy of the same source to the same destination (409 already_copied). update refreshes the existing copy with one delta run (or copies when none exists); new always creates another copy.

batch_id.description: Groups the links of one batch. Derived from the batch key so a replay keeps it; the fair-share unit of the queue.

after_copy_sync_mode.description: Configure sync on the collection this job creates, after a successful initial copy. Omit to use the principal's preference; off disables it for this copy.

priority.description: Queue priority; higher runs first. Default 0.

batch_id.description: Set when this job is one link of a batch (S6).

on_conflict.description: Decision for a name already taken at the destination (never overwrites).

timezone.description: IANA timezone used for schedules and date display (e.g. Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh).

daily_report.description: Send a short daily Telegram report at daily_report_at.

daily_report_at.description: Local time in the preferences timezone (HH:MM).

retention_days.description: Retention window in days; 0 means keep forever
Retention window in days; 0 means keep forever

paused.description: Global queue pause (S6): queued jobs wait; running jobs settle to paused.

on_conflict.description: Decision for a name already taken at the destination (never overwrites).

repairable_findings.description: Findings a repair run can fix and has not fixed yet.

FilterSpec.description: Selective sync rule (S5). Rules: glob (a pattern without / matches the name; with / it matches the path below the root, ** spans segments), ext:.pdf, class:image|video|audio|doc|archive|native|other. Exclude always wins over include.

confirm_name.description: Required when dry_run is false; must equal the collection's destination root name.

Error410.description: Cursor history expired; refetch job snapshot

DefaultError.description: Redacted error envelope. Status/code mapping is defined in docs/control-contracts.md; includes 400/401/403/404/409/410/413/429/500/502/503/504.
